City of Encinitas
San Dieguito Water District 5:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 20, 2023 -
05:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
S1.
CALL TO ORDER
San Dieguito Water District Board Members receive an independent stipend of $100 for convening the Water District meetings pursuant to San Dieguito Water District Resolution No. 89-07.
S2.
ROLL CALL
S3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
S4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS – NONE
S5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
(30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the General Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
S6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
S7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA
Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
S8.
CONSENT CALENDAR
The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Board Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval to waive the full reading of the text of all ordinances and resolutions introduced/adopted at this meeting. Ordinances and resolutions shall be introduced/adopted by title only. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve.
8B.
Approval of the Minutes of the November 15, 2023, Regular Meeting and November 28, 2023, Special Closed Session Meeting. Contact Person: Board Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2023-12-20 SDWD Item S08B SDWD Minutes
8C.
Approval of the Warrants List (Register of Demands). Contact Person: Finance Manager Dinh
Staff recommends that the Board review and approve the warrants.
2023-12-20 SDWD Item S08C SDWD Approval of Warrants List
8D.
Memorandum of Understanding - Pilot Study for Commercial, Industrial, and Institutional (CII) Dedicated Irrigation Meters (DIMs) and Mixed-Use Meters (MUMs). Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the City Council is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Water Resource Specialist Han
Authorize the General Manager, or designee, to execute the Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with the California Data Collaborative (CaDC).
2023-12-20 SDWD Item S08D MOU- Pilot Study for CII DIMs and MUMs
8E.
Quitclaim of Water Easement to Corradini-Atchley Living Trust April 8, 2021, located at 1020 Nolbey Street, Encinitas CA 92007 (APN 260-473-10-00). Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the District Board is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Principal Engineer Hariri
1) Adopt Resolution No 2023-19, titled "A Resolution of the Board of Directors of San Dieguito Water District Approving Quitclaim of Water Easement on 1020 Nolbey Street, Encinitas CA 92007 (APN 260-473-10-00)"; and 2) Authorize the General Manager to file a Quitclaim Deed of Public Water Easement.
2023-12-20 SDWD Item S08E Quitclaim 1020 Nolbey St
8F.
Approval of the 2024 San Dieguito Water District Board meeting schedule. Environmental Considerations: The action being considered by the Board of Directors, approval of the 2024 San Dieguito Water District Board Meeting Schedule, is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) because it is not a "project" under Section 15378(b)(5) of CEQA Guidelines. The action involves an organizational or administrative activity of government that will not result in the direct or indirect physical change in the environment. Contact Person: Finance Manager II Kazungu
District Board adopt Resolution 2023-20, titled "A Resolution of the Board of Directors of the San Dieguito Water District Approving the 2024 San Dieguito Water District Board Meeting Schedule."
2023-12-20 SDWD Item S08F 2024 Board Meeting Schedule
S9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR
Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
S10.
ACTION ITEMS – NONE
To speak on action items, please submit a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present.
S11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS – NONE
To speak on informational items, please submit a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Board. A maximum of two time donations per speaker is allowed (no more than 9 minutes total); the person donating time must be present.
S12.
BOARD MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
S13.
GENERAL INFORMATION / STAFF STATUS REPORTS
13A.
General Manager Update/Report
S14.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR BOARD MEETING WILL BE HELD ON JANUARY 17, 2023
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
